question: The Missionaries of Charity is a Catholic religious congregation established in ___________ by Mother Teresa.
solution:
The correct answer is__ '**1950'**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mother Teresa**, also recognized in the Catholic Church as Saint Teresa of Calcutta, founded the Missionaries of Charity.
 
• On **o****ctober 7,1950** mother Teresa established **The Missionaries of Charity**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• All around the world, including the former **Soviet Union** and Eastern European nations, the Society of Missionaries has spread. They assist the poorest of the poor in several nations in **Asia, Africa, and Latin America**.
 
• Mother Teresa got approval from the Holy See on October 7, 1950, to create her own order, "The Missionaries of Charity," whose main goal was to **love** and **care** for those that no one else was willing to take care of.
